top_selected_path.hypothesis: AI consultancies and automation agencies will pay for a fast implementation-readiness review that reduces delivery risk.
top_selected_path.target_customer: AI operations consultancies and automation agencies
top_selected_path.expected_pain: implementation bottlenecks, agent reliability questions, governance/compliance uncertainty
top_selected_path.required_outbound_action: governed low-risk outbound after live provider sandbox
top_selected_path.provider_requirement: live provider sandbox and persistent idempotency
top_selected_path.first_test_action: provider-sandbox canary plan for one low-risk target after live tests
top_selected_path.money_reason: closest existing offer, existing target set, low owner burden, short path to paid diagnostic
top_selected_path.failure_reason: targets may not feel acute enough pain or may treat review as consulting commodity

backup_paths.hypothesis: Teams adopting agents may pay for a governance and safety audit before production deployment.
backup_paths.offer: AI Agent Governance and Safety Audit
backup_paths.expected_pain: fear of unsafe autonomy, auditability gaps, customer trust concerns
backup_paths.required_outbound_action: evidence expansion then dry-run targeted outreach
backup_paths.first_test_action: produce one audit teardown sample from repo artifacts
backup_paths.money_reason: clear differentiation from generic AI automation consulting
backup_paths.failure_reason: market may view governance as nice-to-have until post-incident
governance_constraints: bind all claims to repo evidence

backup_paths.hypothesis: Founder-led AI teams may pay for governed outbound/dry-run infrastructure to reduce spam and compliance risk.
backup_paths.offer: Governed Autonomous Outbound Dry-Run and Compliance Control Plane
backup_paths.expected_pain: need revenue validation without spam risk or founder operations drag
backup_paths.provider_requirement: sandbox or local demo enough before live
backup_paths.first_test_action: package E22/E23 as demo story and dry-run proof
backup_paths.money_reason: turns internal execution infrastructure into sellable capability
backup_paths.failure_reason: buyers may prefer simpler CRM/email tooling unless pain is explicit

backup_paths.hypothesis: Other founders may value a CEO-agent control room that maps opportunities to governed execution.
backup_paths.expected_pain: strategy scattered across docs, agents, and experiments with no execution route
backup_paths.required_outbound_action: demo-led validation after E24 artifacts stabilize
backup_paths.provider_requirement: dry-run enough for demo; live later
backup_paths.first_test_action: publish no external demo internally and prepare founder interview script
backup_paths.money_reason: dogfoodable and differentiated by governance/execution routing
backup_paths.failure_reason: may be too abstract without concrete revenue outcome

rejected_paths.hypothesis: Small teams may buy a practical review of AI automation bottlenecks and near-term ROI.
rejected_paths.expected_pain: too many AI ideas, unclear ROI, no safe implementation order
rejected_paths.required_outbound_action: evidence expansion and dry-run variant test
rejected_paths.first_test_action: rewrite message variant around founder ROI bottleneck
rejected_paths.money_reason: broad, understandable pain and straightforward consulting purchase
rejected_paths.failure_reason: too generic without proof and tighter ICP

blocked_paths.hypothesis: A paid diagnostic product can convert low-trust outreach into a compact purchase path.
blocked_paths.expected_pain: need a small first step before larger implementation
blocked_paths.required_outbound_action: no-send offer test then owner-approved payment setup later
blocked_paths.provider_requirement: not provider-send first; payment/legal boundary later
blocked_paths.first_test_action: create sample diagnostic scope without collecting payment
blocked_paths.money_reason: shortest literal cash path if buyer pain is clear
blocked_paths.failure_reason: payment path and trust proof are not ready

evidence_needed_paths.hypothesis: The provider adapter and promotion gate could become infrastructure sold to agent builders.
evidence_needed_paths.target_customer: AI agent platforms needing safe outbound execution
evidence_needed_paths.expected_pain: moving from simulations to live execution safely
evidence_needed_paths.provider_requirement: provider live scaffold remains disabled until configured
evidence_needed_paths.first_test_action: document integration story and target partner list from repo evidence
evidence_needed_paths.money_reason: technical differentiation and trust layer value
evidence_needed_paths.failure_reason: infrastructure sale may be slower than service revenue

rationale: The readiness-review path has the most repo-grounded offer/target evidence and can reuse dry-run/control-plane assets; live provider remains the bottleneck before real execution.
